families.axis: flat naming of dullness → slangy contempt for rigid, predictable sameness

members.tone: Flat and unheated, naming the conformity without delivering the disapproval, so the verdict has to be inferred.
Informal and needling, making the conventionality sound like a tidy uniform where *conventional* merely states it.
The same needle with an extra syllable of drawl, drawing the mockery out a beat longer than *button-down*.
So understated it can pass for plain description, framing the dullness as caution and letting the sting arrive quietly.
Slangy and dismissive, writing someone off as comically out of step rather than merely dull.
Flat slang for the same rigidity, labelling rather than jeering, so it lands softer than *square*.

members.gloss: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
members.tone: Damning by diagnosis, treating the sameness as fixed and mechanically repeated rather than just uninspired.

members.gloss: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
members.tone: Drier and more technical, its clinical flatness muting the derision that *stereotypical* carries.

members.gloss: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
members.tone: Everyday and derisive, the predictability sharp enough that the thing is seen coming.

members.gloss: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
members.tone: The plainest naming of the deficit, no slang and no figure, just the absence stated as the fault.

families.axis: bare certainty of knowledge → esteem so vast it passes into legend

members.tone: Flat and bare, asserting certainty about a thing with no admiration attached, the zero point the rest of the family builds on.
Superlative but measured, ranking one above all others for familiarity without claiming any grandeur beyond that ranking.

members.gloss: more familiar or renowned than the other of two
members.tone: Comparative and narrow, weighing exactly two and awarding the margin rather than any absolute standing like *best-known*.
Esteem heard as applause, the acclaim voiced aloud where *noted* keeps it under its breath.
A literary lift over *famous*, the same esteem sounding sung rather than simply reported.
Heightened and balladic, stretching the esteem across distance until it sounds too grand for plain prose.
The unadorned member, stating full esteem without ceremony, the plain standard *illustrious* and *far-famed* rise above.
Formal and lofty, loading the esteem with dignity and splendour that *famous* never claims.
The faintest esteem in the group, granting that someone is worth remarking on rather than widely admired.
Dry and restrained, conceding the esteem without raising its voice, next to the applause in *celebrated*.
Grand and resonant, the esteem sounding proclaimed rather than merely acknowledged as in *noted*.

members.gloss: having the identity known or established
members.tone: Coolly procedural, pinning down which thing it is and saying nothing whatever about standing.

members.gloss: so celebrated as to having taken on the nature of a legend
members.tone: The extreme of the family, where esteem has swollen past fact into story and outstrips even *illustrious*.
Familiarity by constant repetition, the thing quoted as a byword rather than admired as *famous* implies.
Broad and flat, measuring how far knowledge reaches while withholding the esteem carried by *famous*.

families.axis: bare absence of formality → emphatic, warm familiarity

members.tone: The flat negative of formal, marking the absence and nothing more - no warmth, no reproach, no picture of the occasion.

members.gloss: appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
members.tone: Carries the ease of the ordinary occasion rather than its regularity, lighter on the tongue than *everyday*.

members.gloss: appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
members.tone: Plain and matter-of-fact, fixing suitability to the routine occasion instead of to a relaxed manner.

members.gloss: appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
members.tone: The most literal of the routine words here, measuring fitness by the recurring occasion with no suggestion of ease at all.
Approving and chatty - informality as unforced naturalness, praising what is unstudied rather than merely noting what is absent.
Pushes informality into warm closeness, a homely familiarity well past *casual*'s mere ease.
Frames the informality as ceremony stripped off, with a brusqueness *casual* never carries.
The flatter, more clinical twin of *unceremonious*, stating the lack of ceremony without the abrupt edge.

families.axis: bare capability of being reached → easy, welcome, convenient nearness

members.tone: The plain, unemotional member: reachability stated as a bare fact, with none of the ease that *approachable* grants.
Warmer than *reachable* - the ease reads as a small compliment to the thing reached.
Flat and literal where *approachable* is inviting: it registers the ease and adds nothing to it.

members.gloss: capable of being reached or attained
members.tone: A homely, knockabout compound that sounds improvised beside the smooth *accessible*, and stretches past places to things attained.

members.gloss: capable of being reached or attained
members.tone: Blunter and more physical than *come-at-able*, its hyphens staging a bit of effort in the getting.

members.gloss: capable of being reached or attained
members.tone: The same colloquial compound run into one lump, clumsier on the page than hyphenated *get-at-able* and no different in force.
Openly approving and informal: closeness treated as a convenience worth having, not the neutral fact *accessible* records.
A measured phrase rather than a word, stating immediate availability with a poise that *handy* cheerfully drops.

families.axis: flat registration that one knows something → keen, quickened responsiveness of mind

members.gloss: (sometimes followed by ‘of’) having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
members.tone: The plain, unweighted term for holding something in mind, stating the knowing without praising or grading the mind that holds it.

members.gloss: (sometimes followed by ‘of’) having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
members.tone: Formal and stiff where *aware* is plain, giving the same knowledge an official, almost declarative weight.

members.gloss: (sometimes followed by ‘of’) having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
members.tone: The British spelling of *cognizant*, carrying the identical formal stiffness and no extra force.
Praises the mind as quick on its feet - perception poised to respond, not merely present as in *aware*.
Casts perceptiveness as vitality, a mind quickened and answering rather than simply watchful.
Frames the perceptive mind as roused and taking things in, with dullness implied as what it has risen out of.

members.gloss: (followed by ‘of’) showing realization or recognition of something
members.tone: Aims the awareness at a particular thing and marks it as recognized, more deliberate and pointed than bare *aware*.

members.gloss: aware intuitively or intellectually of something sensed
members.tone: Formal and faintly literary, giving the awareness a felt quality - something registered as much as reasoned.

families.axis: bare exactness → exactness pushed past its use

members.gloss: sharply exact or accurate or delimited
members.tone: The family's flat baseline: states that something is exact or sharply bounded, passing no verdict on whether the exactness is welcome.
Absolute and informal, an intensifier of accuracy that allows no margin of error at all, where *precise* still admits degrees.

members.gloss: minutely precise especially in differences in meaning
members.tone: Approving of exactness at the smallest scale, the drawing of distinctions almost too slight to mark, without *finespun*'s charge of overdoing it.
Disapproval delivered gently, as an aesthetic complaint: the detail is delicate but spun out finer than the thing can bear.
Blunt dismissal of the same excess *finespun* deprecates, naming it a quarrel over distinctions too small to be worth drawing.

members.gloss: marked by precise accordance with details
members.tone: Warm praise for care taken over every detail, crediting the attention rather than the rulebook.

members.gloss: marked by precise accordance with details
members.tone: Formal and stiff, treating exact detail as an observance to be complied with, where *meticulous* treats it as care.

members.gloss: extremely precise with great attention to details
members.tone: Hyperbolic magnification of *meticulous*, exactness pushed to a scale where the smallest detail is still under the lens.
Praise for a fine touch, exactness felt as delicacy of hand rather than accumulated care.
Open, unsubtle praise of the doer's competence, where *nice* praises the fineness of the execution itself.

members.gloss: being precise with regard to a prescribed or specified criterion
members.tone: Informal and satisfied: a verdict that the thing landed square on the stated mark, not a description of exactness in the abstract.

members.gloss: being precise with regard to a prescribed or specified criterion
members.tone: The same informal verdict of an exact hit as *on the nose*, with a crisper, more percussive snap to it.
Approving of precision arrived at by paring away the coarse, a finished quality rather than an effort under way.
A bare intensifier of identity, insisting the thing is exactly the one stated and carrying no praise or blame with it.

families.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

members.tone: The plain cover term, working equally for the thing that gives the discomfort and the body that feels it, which is what keeps it so flat.

members.gloss: feeling physical discomfort or pain (‘tough’ is occasionally used colloquially for ‘bad’)
members.tone: Blunt and unspecific about the body feeling wrong, naming neither the site nor the sharpness of what is felt.

members.gloss: feeling physical discomfort or pain (‘tough’ is occasionally used colloquially for ‘bad’)
members.tone: The colloquial counterpart to *bad*, looser and more offhand about the same felt discomfort.
States a lack rather than a hurt — the bleakness sits in what is missing, which makes it colder than *uncomfortable*.
Points at discomfort that nags and chafes, a lower-grade complaint than *painful* though the two name the same effect.
The heavier word for that same effect, putting the discomfort on the scale of hurt rather than annoyance.
Gathers the discomfort into a whole bodily condition instead of a single sensation, so it reads as total rather than local.
A degree past *miserable* on the same misery — abject, with no dignity left to the body it describes.

members.gloss: relating to bodily unease that causes discomfort
members.tone: The faintest of these: a bodily unsettledness that has not hardened into pain, more a hint than a hurt.

members.gloss: uncomfortable because of possible danger or trouble
members.tone: Locates the discomfort in looming danger or trouble rather than in the flesh, and its mildness is exactly what makes it sound like a warning.

families.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

members.gloss: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established standards or rules
members.tone: Plain, unarguable approval - it certifies that no favoritism or deception got in, without the weight of principle *just* carries.

members.gloss: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established standards or rules
members.tone: Heavier than *fair* - the same absence of bias, but weighted as a standard rightly upheld rather than a condition merely met.

members.gloss: of laws and regulations; designed to protect trade and commerce from unfair business practices
members.tone: Purely classificatory - it says what a law or regulation is built to protect trade from, and commends no one.

members.gloss: of laws and regulations; designed to protect trade and commerce from unfair business practices
members.tone: Technical and as neutral as *antimonopoly*, marking a regulation's protective purpose rather than approving anybody's conduct.

members.gloss: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play
members.tone: Approves by negation - nothing foul in the play - where *sportsmanlike* names the virtue outright.

members.gloss: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play
members.tone: Warmer and easier than *clean*, crediting fair play as a spirit brought to the contest rather than a rule left unbroken.

members.gloss: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play
members.tone: The most casual of these, informal and light, granting the same approval with none of *sportsmanlike*'s weight.

members.gloss: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play
members.tone: The formal member - it measures conduct against a named standard of sportsmanship instead of merely reporting, as *clean* does, that nothing foul happened.

members.gloss: of a person; just and impartial; not prejudiced
members.tone: Praises a settled cast of mind rather than a single dealing - the impartiality is lodged in the person.
The emphatic one - its doubled phrasing insists there is nothing left to question, where *just* simply states that the standard was met.
